name: Dokodemo Crash-kun
summary: Dokodemo Crash-kun is a companion application for the Sony PocketStation included with the Japanese release of Crash Bandicoot: Warped. It contains several PocketStation-exclusive mini-games and utilities, including a virtual pet starring Crash Bandicoot, a rhythm game, an endless runner inspired by the series' boulder chase levels, a sliding tile puzzle, a collectible photo album, and a save data viewer. Progress in Crash Bandicoot: Warped unlocks additional content, songs, and features within the PocketStation application, while collected photos can be exchanged with other PocketStations via the infrared port.
